title: Flame Extinguishment Experiment
platform: International Space Station (Combustion Integrated Rack, Multi-user Droplet Combustion Apparatus)
summary: 274 methanol and n-heptane droplets (about 1-5 mm) were burned aboard the ISS at 0.7-3 atm and 12-34% O2, with CO2 or He added as suppressants, to map the limiting oxygen index and flame extinction in microgravity.
